==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Early-Game Rebalance|date=16 February 2026}}
** A number of early-game mobs will once again drop actual armour, weapons, ores, and bars.
*** Medium bladed iron salvage → Iron 2h sword
*** Medium plated iron salvage → Iron chainbody
*** Tiny blunt steel salvage → Steel mace/Steel off hand mace
*** Tiny plated steel salvage → Steel med helm
*** Tiny spiky steel salvage → Steel dagger/Steel off hand dagger, Steel sword/Steel off hand sword
*** Small bladed steel salvage → Steel longsword/Steel off hand longsword
*** Medium bladed steel salvage → Steel 2h sword, Steel battleaxe/Steel off hand battleaxe
*** Medium plated steel salvage → Steel chainbody
*** Tiny spiky mithril salvage → Mithril dagger/Mithril off hand dagger
*** Small bladed mithril salvage → Mithril longsword/Mithril off hand longsword
*** Tiny blunt adamant salvage → Adamant mace/Adamant off hand mace
*** Medium bladed adamant salvage → Adamant 2h sword

* {{UL|type=update|update=Tuska Clean Up - This Week In RuneScape|date=18 August 2025}}
** The Sacrifice, Devotion, and Transfigure abilities have been removed from the God Wars Dungeon I loot table, and are now obtained by completing the One Piercing Note quest.

* {{UL|type=update|update=God Wars Dungeon|date=28 August 2007}}
** Added to game.
}}
